description.purpose: The seed hive of meclaw-os: an empty graph and nothing else. Not one cell is checked in here -- everything this colony is arrives later, from templates, through grow.json.
description.use_when: As the --root of a colony that is grown rather than checked in.
description.not_in_scope: No door, no terminal, no agent, no memory, no screening, no persona: none of that is written here, all of it is instantiated.
